conclusions.boundedCanonicalLowerBound: After original first row Error and existing safe context/prior-row/kind checks, read canonicalInputs through an own data descriptor and count UTF8 only until physical16384 is exceeded. Emit lower bound16385, never exact total length, no parse/codec encoding/raw retention; physical/detail metrics remain null. Multibyte crossing may overshoot16385 internally, but emitted value remains a lower bound.
conclusions.codecFailures: Classify only the four authenticated NativeObserverFormatError codes CANONICAL_OVER_BOUND, FORMAT_INVALID, STRUCTURE_OVER_BOUND, CANONICAL_ROUNDTRIP at the exact INPUT_DETAIL_ENCODE or PREDECESSOR_INPUT_DECODE operation. Require actual typed error and safe own-data code access; native SyntaxError, unknown throw and arbitrary code getters remain unknown/unavailable. These are diagnostics, never accepted resource RED.
conclusions.futureControls: The specified boundary, multibyte, four-code, unsafe-descriptor/getter, output-overflow, earlier-native-error, same-E/cleanup, predecessor-operation and original COUNT_ROW_TOTAL controls are required source-work validation scope. No future roster/count or actual PASS is invented.
conclusions.physicalAlternative: When encoding/reconstruction fully succeeds under existing diagnostic-only structural/byte bounds, retain exact physical/detail/context byte metrics. PHYSICAL_ROW_BYTE_CAP requires reconstructed rowBytes>16384; a row<=cap cannot be relabeled a measured refusal.
conclusions.purity: Known-no-fit path invokes no canonical parse/encoder/getter/toJSON. Original bounded context whitelist, prior physical references, identity/occurrence reconstruction and output<=4096 including newline continue; fallback omits unavailable context explicitly and emits no raw tuple/payload.
conclusions.smallestScope: Change diagnostic metadata and independently affected controls only. Acceptance sink, canonical codec, evaluator/game/fixtures/fullbody assertions and caps remain unchanged.
conclusions.stickyError: Original first row Error remains the actual thrown object; earlier native failure produces no row diagnosis. Existing shared helper body/writer/end/reset precedence, both cleanup attempts, and first-failure latch stay unchanged.
conclusions.version: New metadata is versioned1370-m0-native-observer-row-diagnostic/v2; native physical schema remains unchanged. Existing available-byte meanings are retained.

reviewScope: Independent finite design/source/evidence review only. No candidate imports, tests, runtime, private/dependency traversal, process probes or repository/Git mutation. Root alone may adopt proposed diagnostic source work for a later slice.
sourceReasoning: Native sink checks COUNT first, canonical own-string UTF8>16384 before encoding/parse, then complete native row bytes. Diagnostic currently recognizes diagnosticCode only, while codec raises its own typed code. Unretained transformed-code/map stack offsets cannot resolve which same-message branch actually failed. Lower-bound classification is prospective and does not establish the current actual cause.
